evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: LLM agents can improve across tasks without updating model parameters by storing experience from their own executions in external memory and reusing it to guide later decisions.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across different benchmarks and backbones, Anti-Persistence achieves higher overall held-out success and the lowest average LLM-call cost among the evaluated memory designs.
